patch_description: Key parameters changed: (1) greedy perturb rate tuned to 0.10; (2) added systematic first-improvement relocation/swap sweeps (deterministic full neighborhood scans, not random samples) that run until local optimum; (3) ruin-and-recreate upgraded to accept equal-cost solutions (plateau walks) with ruin size adapted up on stagnation; (4) or-opt style segment relocations of length 1-3 alongside single-txn moves; (5) all imports (time, random) at top of block, validity-preserving moves only, so zero-defect hygiene is enforced. These give a stronger intensification/diversification balance, escaping local optima better than the pure random-move local search.
